metadata.source: Spaciel Road Naming Viewer / V17 registered geometry
metadata.policy: Provisional semantic cleanup: tiny spurs, exact parallel micro-loops, local-yellow class bridges, conservative path simplification. No source-verified road reconstruction or overpass correction; original preserved.

warnings: Provisional cartographic cleanup, not confirmed against source map pixels
Micro-spurs and duplicate edges are hidden in the V19 preview; originals remain in originalRoads / cleanedRoads
Do not treat preview as authoritative routing topology; grade separation and route designation require manual atlas crosscheck
Removed segments retain source indices and can be reinstated
